::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_cell_group`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs field containing the variable to group on. Typically this field contains cell groups such as annotated cell types or clusters.

[Example]{.arg-key} `"cell_type"`

:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.obs fields containing the experimental condition(s) to create pseudobulk samples for.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"treatment"`, `"disease"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}

:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Name of the .var field that contains gene symbols. If not provided, .var.index will be used.

### Filtering options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}

::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}

`--min_obs_per_sample`
:::

Minimum number of observations per pseudobulk sample.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `30`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--filter_genes_min_samples`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Minimum number of samples a gene must be expressed in to be included in the analysis.
If None, no filtering is applied.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Min]{.arg-key} `1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--filter_gene_patterns`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
List of regex patterns to filter out genes.
Genes matching any of these patterns will be excluded from the analysis.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"MIR\\d+"`, `"AL\\d+"`, `"LINC\\d+"`, `"AC\\d+"`, `"AP\\d+"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::::

### DGEA options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--design_formula`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Design formula for DESeq2 analysis in R-style format.
Specifies the statistical model to account for various factors.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"~ cell_type + disease + treatment"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contrast_column`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Column in the metadata to use for the contrast.
This column should contain the conditions to compare.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"treatment"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--contrast_values`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Values to compare in the contrast column.
First value is baseline, following values are different treatments.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"ctrl"`, `"stim"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--p_adj_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Adjusted p-value threshold for significance.
Genes with adjusted p-values below this threshold will be considered significant.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.05`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--log2fc_threshold`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Log2 fold change threshold for significance.
Genes with absolute log2 fold change above this threshold will be considered significant.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.0`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/differential_expression/pseudobulk_deseq2/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/workflows/differential_expression/pseudobulk_deseq2);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/workflows/differential_expression/pseudobulk_deseq2/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
